collection.title: Ford Galaxy 2001 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Galaxy 2001 - 2006 version requires a 28" wiper blade for both drivers and passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. Rear screen wipers for this Galaxy which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
